stemText: In a thermodynamic process, 400 J of heat is supplied to a system and the system performs 150 J of work on its surroundings. The change in the internal energy of the system is:

solution.explanationText: According to the First Law of Thermodynamics, Delta Q = Delta U + W => Delta U = Delta Q - W. Given Delta Q = +400 J and W = +150 J, we have Delta U = 400 J - 150 J = +250 J.

stemText: An ideal gas expands from an initial volume of 0.2 m^3 to a final volume of 0.5 m^3 at a constant pressure of 2 x 10^5 Pa. The work done by the gas during this expansion is:

solution.explanationText: For an isobaric process, work done is W = P * Delta V = P * (V2 - V1). Substituting values: W = (2 x 10^5 Pa) * (0.5 m^3 - 0.2 m^3) = (2 x 10^5) * 0.3 = 6 x 10^4 J.

stemText: A Carnot engine operates between a source at 500 K and a sink at 300 K. The efficiency of this Carnot engine is:

solution.explanationText: The efficiency of a Carnot engine is eta = 1 - T_sink / T_source = 1 - 300 / 500 = 1 - 0.6 = 0.4. In percentage, eta = 0.4 * 100% = 40%.

stemText: For an ideal monoatomic gas having 3 degrees of freedom, the molar heat capacity ratio gamma = C_p / C_v is equal to:

solution.explanationText: For an ideal gas with f degrees of freedom, C_v = (f/2) R and C_p = C_v + R = (1 + f/2) R. For a monoatomic gas (f = 3), C_v = (3/2) R and C_p = (5/2) R. Therefore, gamma = C_p / C_v = (5/2) / (3/2) = 5/3.

stemText: During an isochoric process involving an ideal gas, which of the following physical quantities is always identically zero?

options.label: A
options.text: Change in internal energy Delta U

solution.explanationText: An isochoric process is one in which the volume of the system remains constant (dV = 0). The mechanical work done is W = integral P dV = 0. Hence, work done is identically zero.

stemText: The internal energy of a given mass of an ideal gas depends solely upon its:

solution.explanationText: According to Joule's law for ideal gases, intermolecular potential energy is zero. Therefore, the internal energy of an ideal gas is entirely kinetic and is exclusively a function of its absolute temperature T: U = n C_v T.

stemText: On a P-V indicator diagram, the magnitude of the slope of an adiabatic curve at any point (P, V) compared to the magnitude of the slope of an isothermal curve passing through the same point is:

solution.explanationText: For an isothermal process, P V = constant => dP/dV = - P / V. For a reversible adiabatic process, P V^gamma = constant => V^gamma dP + gamma P V^(gamma - 1) dV = 0 => dP/dV = - gamma (P / V). Thus, |(dP/dV)_adiabatic| = gamma * |(dP/dV)_isothermal|.

stemText: An ideal gas with adiabatic exponent gamma = 1.5 is suddenly compressed adiabatically to one-fourth of its initial volume. If its initial temperature is T0, its final temperature will be:

solution.explanationText: For a reversible adiabatic process, T * V^(gamma - 1) = constant. Therefore, T1 * V1^(gamma - 1) = T2 * V2^(gamma - 1) => T2 = T1 * (V1 / V2)^(gamma - 1). Here V1 / V2 = 4 and gamma - 1 = 1.5 - 1 = 0.5 = 1/2. Thus, T2 = T0 * (4)^(1/2) = 2 T0.

stemText: An ideal gas undergoes a cyclic process represented by an ellipse on the P-V diagram. If the maximum and minimum pressures are 300 kPa and 100 kPa, and the maximum and minimum volumes are 60 L and 20 L, the net work done by the gas in one clockwise cycle is:

solution.explanationText: The net work done per cycle is the area of the ellipse on the P-V diagram: W = pi * a * b, where a = (P_max - P_min) / 2 = (300 - 100) / 2 = 100 kPa = 10^5 Pa, and b = (V_max - V_min) / 2 = (60 - 20) / 2 = 20 L = 20 x 10^-3 m^3. Thus, W = pi * (10^5) * (20 x 10^-3) = 2000 pi J = 2 pi kJ.

stemText: One mole of an ideal monoatomic gas (gamma = 5/3) is mixed with two moles of an ideal diatomic gas (gamma = 7/5). The molar heat capacity at constant volume C_v of the mixture is:

solution.explanationText: For a monoatomic gas (n1 = 1), C_v1 = (3/2) R. For a diatomic gas (n2 = 2), C_v2 = (5/2) R. The equivalent molar heat capacity at constant volume of the mixture is C_v,mix = (n1 C_v1 + n2 C_v2) / (n1 + n2) = [ 1 * (3/2) R + 2 * (5/2) R ] / (1 + 2) = (3/2 R + 5 R) / 3 = (13/2 R) / 3 = (13/6) R.

stemText: An ideal monoatomic gas undergoes a polytropic process according to the equation P V^2 = constant. The molar heat capacity C of the gas during this process is:

solution.explanationText: For a polytropic process P V^x = constant, the molar heat capacity is C = C_v + R / (1 - x). Here x = 2, and for a monoatomic gas C_v = (3/2) R. Substituting gives C = (3/2) R + R / (1 - 2) = (3/2) R - R = (1/2) R = R / 2.

stemText: A refrigerator works between freezing point of water (0 degree Celsius) and room temperature (27 degree Celsius). The theoretical coefficient of performance (COP) of this refrigerator is closest to:

solution.explanationText: Coefficient of performance of a Carnot refrigerator is COP = T_cold / (T_hot - T_cold). Here T_cold = 0 deg C = 273 K and T_hot = 27 deg C = 300 K. Thus, COP = 273 / (300 - 273) = 273 / 27 approx 10.11.

stemText: An ideal gas expands from volume V1 to V2. The work done by the gas is W_iso for an isothermal path, W_adia for an adiabatic path, and W_baric for an isobaric path. The correct order of work done is:

solution.explanationText: On a P-V diagram for expansion from V1 to V2 starting from the same initial state (P1, V1): the isobaric curve is a horizontal line having the highest pressure throughout. The isothermal curve lies below the isobaric curve, and the adiabatic curve drops even steeper and lies below the isothermal curve. Since work done is the area under the curve: W_baric > W_iso > W_adia.

translations.stemText: ஒரு நல்லியல்பு வாயு பருமன் V1 இலிருந்து V2 வரை விரிவடைகிறது. செய்யப்பட்ட வேலை மாறா வெப்பநிலைப் பாதையில் W_iso, வெப்பப் பரிமாற்றமில்லா பாதையில் W_adia, மற்றும் மாறா அழுத்தப் பாதையில் W_baric ஆகும். செய்யப்பட்ட வேலையின் சரியான வரிசை:

stemText: When an ideal diatomic gas (gamma = 7/5) expands at constant pressure, the fraction of heat supplied that is converted into work is:

solution.explanationText: In an isobaric process, heat supplied is Delta Q = n C_p Delta T and work done is W = P Delta V = n R Delta T. The fraction converted into work is W / Delta Q = (n R Delta T) / (n C_p Delta T) = R / C_p = (C_p - C_v) / C_p = 1 - 1/gamma = (gamma - 1) / gamma. For a diatomic gas (gamma = 7/5): W / Delta Q = (7/5 - 1) / (7/5) = (2/5) / (7/5) = 2/7.

stemText: The mean free path lambda of molecules of an ideal gas of molecular diameter d and number density n is given by:

solution.explanationText: The standard expression for the mean free path of gas molecules considering the relative velocity distribution of colliding molecules is lambda = 1 / (sqrt(2) * n * pi * d^2).

stemText: An ideal gas is enclosed in an insulated container and expands freely into an evacuated chamber of equal volume. For this free expansion process:

options.label: A
options.text: Delta U = 0, Delta T = 0, and Delta S_system > 0

options.label: B
options.text: Delta U = 0, Delta T < 0, and Delta S_system = 0

options.label: C
options.text: W > 0, Delta Q = 0, and Delta S_system = 0

options.label: D
options.text: Delta U < 0, Delta T = 0, and Delta S_system > 0

solution.explanationText: In free expansion against vacuum: external pressure P_ext = 0, so work done W = 0. Since the container is insulated, heat transfer Delta Q = 0. By First Law, Delta U = Delta Q - W = 0. For an ideal gas, U depends only on temperature, so Delta U = 0 implies Delta T = 0. However, free expansion is an irreversible process, so the entropy of the system increases: Delta S_system = n R ln(V_final / V_initial) = n R ln(2) > 0.

translations.stemText: வெப்பக் கடத்தாத கொள்கலனில் அடைக்கப்பட்டுள்ள ஒரு நல்லியல்பு வாயு, வெற்றிடமாக்கப்பட்ட சம பருமன் கொண்ட மற்றொரு அறைக்குள் தடையின்றி விரிவடைகிறது. இந்த சுயாதீன விரிவடைதல் (free expansion) நிகழ்விற்கு:

stemText: A Carnot engine operates in reverse as a heat pump to warm a room maintained at 27 degree Celsius by extracting heat from the outside environment at -3 degree Celsius. The coefficient of performance of this heat pump (COP_HP = Q_hot / W) is:

solution.explanationText: For a heat pump, COP_HP = Q_hot / W = T_hot / (T_hot - T_cold). Here T_hot = 27 deg C = 300 K, and T_cold = -3 deg C = 270 K. Thus, COP_HP = 300 / (300 - 270) = 300 / 30 = 10. (Note: COP_HP = COP_ref + 1 = 9 + 1 = 10).

stemText: The isothermal bulk modulus B_iso and adiabatic bulk modulus B_adia of an ideal gas at pressure P are respectively:

options.label: A
options.text: B_iso = P and B_adia = gamma P

options.label: B
options.text: B_iso = gamma P and B_adia = P

options.label: C
options.text: B_iso = P / gamma and B_adia = P

options.label: D
options.text: B_iso = P and B_adia = P / gamma

solution.explanationText: Bulk modulus is B = - V (dP/dV). For an isothermal process (P V = C), dP/dV = - P / V => B_iso = - V (- P / V) = P. For an adiabatic process (P V^gamma = C), dP/dV = - gamma P / V => B_adia = - V (- gamma P / V) = gamma P. Hence B_iso = P and B_adia = gamma P.

stemText: During an adiabatic expansion of n moles of an ideal gas from state (P1, V1, T1) to (P2, V2, T2), the work done by the gas is given by:

solution.explanationText: For an adiabatic process, Delta Q = 0, so W = - Delta U = - n C_v (T2 - T1) = n C_v (T1 - T2). Since C_v = R / (gamma - 1), we have W = n R (T1 - T2) / (gamma - 1) = (P1 V1 - P2 V2) / (gamma - 1).

translations.stemText: ஒரு நல்லியல்பு வாயுவின் n மோல்கள் (P1, V1, T1) நிலையிலிருந்து (P2, V2, T2) நிலைக்கு வெப்பப் பரிமாற்றமில்லா விரிவடைதலின் போது, வாயு செய்த வேலை:

stemText: Two identical glass bulbs containing an ideal gas at temperature T0 and pressure P0 are connected by a thin tube of negligible volume. One bulb is placed in a bath at temperature T1 and the other in a bath at temperature T2. The common final pressure P of the system is:

solution.explanationText: Total number of moles of gas is conserved: n_total = n1 + n2. Initially, both bulbs (volume V each) are at T0 and P0: n_total = 2 * (P0 V / (R T0)). In the final state, both bulbs have common pressure P: n1 = P V / (R T1) and n2 = P V / (R T2). Thus, 2 P0 V / (R T0) = (P V / R) * (1/T1 + 1/T2) => 2 P0 / T0 = P * (T1 + T2) / (T1 T2) => P = 2 P0 T1 T2 / [T0 (T1 + T2)].

translations.stemText: T0 வெப்பநிலை மற்றும் P0 அழுத்தத்தில் நல்லியல்பு வாயுவைக் கொண்டுள்ள இரு ஒத்த கண்ணாடி குமிழ்கள் புறக்கணிக்கத்தக்க பருமனுடைய மெல்லிய குழாயால் இணைக்கப்பட்டுள்ளன. ஒரு குமிழ் T1 வெப்பநிலையிலும் மற்றொன்று T2 வெப்பநிலையிலும் வைக்கப்படுகின்றன. அமைப்பின் பொதுவான இறுதி அழுத்தம் P:

stemText: An ideal gas is taken through a cyclic thermodynamic process consisting of straight lines forming a rectangle on a P-V diagram. The pressure varies between 100 kPa and 300 kPa, and the volume varies between 1 m^3 and 4 m^3. If the cycle is traversed in a clockwise direction, the net work done by the gas in one complete cycle is _____ kJ.

solution.explanationText: For a rectangular cyclic process traversed clockwise on a P-V diagram, the net work done is the area of the rectangle: W = (P_high - P_low) * (V_high - V_low) = (300 kPa - 100 kPa) * (4 m^3 - 1 m^3) = (200 kPa) * (3 m^3) = 600 kJ.

translations.stemText: P-V வரைபடத்தில் ஒரு செவ்வகத்தை உருவாக்கும் நேர்கோடுகளைக் கொண்ட ஒரு சுழற்சி வெப்ப இயக்கவியல் செயல்முறைக்கு ஒரு நல்லியல்பு வாயு உட்படுத்தப்படுகிறது. அழுத்தம் 100 kPa மற்றும் 300 kPa இடையேயும், பருமன் 1 m^3 மற்றும் 4 m^3 இடையேயும் மாறுகிறது. சுழற்சி வலஞ்சுழி திசையில் அமைந்தால், ஒரு முழு சுழற்சியில் வாயு செய்த நிகர வேலை _____ kJ.

stemText: A heat engine absorbs 2000 J of thermal energy from a high-temperature reservoir and discharges 1500 J of heat to a low-temperature sink in each cycle. The thermal efficiency of the engine is _____ %.

solution.explanationText: Work done per cycle is W = Q_in - Q_out = 2000 J - 1500 J = 500 J. The thermal efficiency is eta = (W / Q_in) * 100% = (500 J / 2000 J) * 100% = 25%.

translations.stemText: ஒரு வெப்ப இயந்திரம் ஒவ்வொரு சுழற்சியிலும் அதிக வெப்பநிலை மூலத்திலிருந்து 2000 J வெப்ப ஆற்றலை உறிஞ்சி, குறைந்த வெப்பநிலை ஏற்பிக்கு 1500 J வெப்பத்தை வெளியேற்றுகிறது. இயந்திரத்தின் வெப்ப பயனுறுதிறன் _____ %.

stemText: During a thermodynamic expansion, 500 J of heat is added to a gas while the gas expands and does 300 J of work on its surroundings. The increase in the internal energy of the gas is _____ J.

solution.explanationText: By the First Law of Thermodynamics: Delta Q = Delta U + W => Delta U = Delta Q - W = 500 J - 300 J = 200 J.

translations.stemText: ஒரு வெப்ப இயக்கவியல் விரிவடைதலின் போது, ஒரு வாயுவிற்கு 500 J வெப்பம் சேர்க்கப்படும் வேளையில் வாயு விரிவடைந்து சூழ்நிலையின் மீது 300 J வேலையைச் செய்கிறது. வாயுவின் அக ஆற்றலில் ஏற்படும் அதிகரிப்பு _____ J.

stemText: The root-mean-square (rms) speed of helium gas molecules (molar mass = 4 g/mol) at temperature 40 K is equal to the rms speed of oxygen molecules (molar mass = 32 g/mol) at temperature T. The value of T is _____ K.

solution.explanationText: The rms speed of gas molecules is v_rms = sqrt(3 R T / M). Setting v_rms(O2) = v_rms(He): sqrt(3 R T_O2 / M_O2) = sqrt(3 R T_He / M_He) => T_O2 / M_O2 = T_He / M_He => T_O2 = T_He * (M_O2 / M_He) = 40 K * (32 / 4) = 40 * 8 = 320 K.

translations.stemText: 40 K வெப்பநிலையில் ஹீலியம் வாயு மூலக்கூறுகளின் (மோலார் நிறை = 4 g/mol) சராசரி இருமடி மூல (rms) வேகம், T வெப்பநிலையில் உள்ள ஆக்சிஜன் மூலக்கூறுகளின் (மோலார் நிறை = 32 g/mol) rms வேகத்திற்குச் சமம் எனில், T இன் மதிப்பு _____ K.

stemText: Two moles of an ideal diatomic gas (gamma = 7/5) expand adiabatically such that the temperature of the gas drops from 400 K to 300 K. The work done by the gas during this expansion is expressed as N * R Joules, where R is the universal gas constant. Find the integer value of N.

solution.explanationText: The work done during an adiabatic process is W = n R (T1 - T2) / (gamma - 1). Given n = 2 moles, T1 = 400 K, T2 = 300 K, and gamma = 7/5: gamma - 1 = 7/5 - 1 = 2/5 = 0.4. Therefore, W = [2 * R * (400 - 300)] / 0.4 = (2 * R * 100) / 0.4 = 200 R / 0.4 = 500 R Joules. Thus, N = 500.

translations.stemText: இரண்டு மோல்கள் கொண்ட ஒரு நல்லியல்பு ஈரணு வாயு (gamma = 7/5) வெப்பப் பரிமாற்றமில்லா முறையில் விரிவடையும் போது வாயுவின் வெப்பநிலை 400 K இலிருந்து 300 K ஆக குறைகிறது. இந்த விரிவடைதலின் போது வாயு செய்த வேலை N * R ஜூல் எனில் (R என்பது பொது வாயு மாறிலி), N இன் முழு எண் மதிப்பு:

stemText: Four moles of an ideal monoatomic gas are heated at constant volume so that the temperature rises by 50 K. The heat supplied to the gas is N * R Joules, where R is the universal gas constant. Find the value of N.

solution.explanationText: At constant volume, heat supplied is Delta Q = n C_v Delta T. For an ideal monoatomic gas, C_v = (3/2) R. Given n = 4 moles and Delta T = 50 K: Delta Q = 4 * ((3/2) R) * 50 = 6 R * 50 = 300 R Joules. Comparing with N * R, we have N = 300.

translations.stemText: நான்கு மோல்கள் கொண்ட ஒரு நல்லியல்பு ஓரணு வாயு மாறா பருமனில் சூடேற்றப்பட்டு அதன் வெப்பநிலை 50 K உயருகிறது. வாயுவிற்கு வழங்கப்பட்ட வெப்பம் N * R ஜூல் எனில் (R என்பது பொது வாயு மாறிலி), N இன் மதிப்பு:

stemText: A Carnot engine working with a sink at 300 K has an efficiency of 40%. In order to increase its efficiency to 50% while keeping the sink temperature unchanged, the temperature of the source must be increased by _____ K.

solution.explanationText: Initial efficiency eta1 = 1 - T_sink / T_source1 => 0.40 = 1 - 300 / T_source1 => 300 / T_source1 = 0.60 => T_source1 = 300 / 0.60 = 500 K. For the new efficiency eta2 = 0.50 with the same sink: 0.50 = 1 - 300 / T_source2 => 300 / T_source2 = 0.50 => T_source2 = 300 / 0.50 = 600 K. The required increase in the source temperature is Delta T_source = 600 K - 500 K = 100 K.

translations.stemText: 300 K வெப்பநிலையில் உள்ள வெப்ப ஏற்பியுடன் இயங்கும் ஒரு கார்னோ இயந்திரத்தின் பயனுறுதிறன் 40% ஆகும். ஏற்பியின் வெப்பநிலையை மாற்றாமல் அதன் பயனுறுதிறனை 50% ஆக அதிகரிக்க, வெப்ப மூலத்தின் வெப்பநிலையை _____ K அதிகரிக்க வேண்டும்.

stemText: An ideal gas is taken along a closed triangular thermodynamic cycle on a P-V diagram with vertices at (1 m^3, 100 kPa), (4 m^3, 100 kPa), and (4 m^3, 300 kPa) in a clockwise sense. The net work done by the gas in one complete cycle is _____ kJ.

solution.explanationText: The net work done in a cyclic process equals the area enclosed by the cycle on the P-V diagram. For this right-angled triangle: Base = (4 - 1) m^3 = 3 m^3, and Height = (300 - 100) kPa = 200 kPa. Area = (1/2) * Base * Height = (1/2) * (3 m^3) * (200 kPa) = 300 kJ.

translations.stemText: ஒரு நல்லியல்பு வாயு P-V வரைபடத்தில் (1 m^3, 100 kPa), (4 m^3, 100 kPa), மற்றும் (4 m^3, 300 kPa) ஆகிய முனைகளைக் கொண்ட ஒரு மூடிய முக்கோண சுழற்சியில் வலஞ்சுழியாக இயக்கப்படுகிறது. ஒரு முழு சுழற்சியில் வாயு செய்த நிகர வேலை _____ kJ.

stemText: Three moles of an ideal monoatomic gas undergo a thermodynamic process in which the pressure is directly proportional to its volume (P = alpha * V, where alpha is a constant). If the temperature of the gas increases by 20 K during this process, the total heat supplied to the gas is N * R Joules, where R is the universal gas constant. Find the integer value of N.

solution.explanationText: The given process is P V^-1 = alpha (constant), which is a polytropic process with index x = -1. The molar heat capacity for a polytropic process is C = C_v + R / (1 - x). For a monoatomic gas, C_v = (3/2) R. Therefore, C = (3/2) R + R / (1 - (-1)) = (3/2) R + (1/2) R = 2 R. The total heat supplied is Delta Q = n C Delta T = 3 * (2 R) * 20 = 120 R Joules. Thus, N = 120.

translations.stemText: மூன்று மோல்கள் கொண்ட ஒரு நல்லியல்பு ஓரணு வாயு, அழுத்தம் அதன் பருமனுக்கு நேர்விகிதத்தில் உள்ள ஒரு செயல்முறைக்கு உட்படுகிறது (P = alpha * V, alpha என்பது மாறிலி). இந்நிகழ்வின் போது வாயுவின் வெப்பநிலை 20 K அதிகரித்தால், வாயுவிற்கு வழங்கப்பட்ட மொத்த வெப்பம் N * R ஜூல் எனில் (R என்பது பொது வாயு மாறிலி), N இன் முழு எண் மதிப்பு:

stemText: Two insulated rigid vessels of volumes 2 L and 3 L containing an ideal gas at the same temperature 300 K are at pressures 100 kPa and 200 kPa respectively. If a valve connecting the two vessels is opened and the system reaches equilibrium at 300 K, the final equilibrium pressure of the gas is _____ kPa.

solution.explanationText: Since temperature remains unchanged (T = 300 K), the total number of moles is conserved: n_total = n1 + n2 => P_final * V_total / (R T) = (P1 V1 / R T) + (P2 V2 / R T) => P_final * (V1 + V2) = P1 V1 + P2 V2. Substituting values: P_final * (2 L + 3 L) = (100 kPa * 2 L) + (200 kPa * 3 L) => 5 * P_final = 200 + 600 = 800 kPa L => P_final = 800 / 5 = 160 kPa.

translations.stemText: ஒரே வெப்பநிலை 300 K இல் நல்லியல்பு வாயுவைக் கொண்டுள்ள 2 L மற்றும் 3 L பருமனுடைய இரு வெப்பக்கடத்தா திடமான கலன்களின் அழுத்தங்கள் முறையே 100 kPa மற்றும் 200 kPa ஆகும். இரு கலன்களையும் இணைக்கும் ஒரு வால்வு திறக்கப்பட்டு, அமைப்பு 300 K இல் சமநிலையை அடைந்தால், வாயுவின் இறுதி சமநிலை அழுத்தம் _____ kPa.
